text:
sam: FYI I'm opening a PR to switch our NATGW allocation from one-off EIPs to an operator-managed EIP pool across AZs. hoping for quick 👀 before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512

infra-bot: terraform plan (staging) — 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy :spiral_notepad:

jess: quick q — is this one EIP per AZ (sticky) or a pool you borrow from on create? curious about failover behavior.

sam: it's a small pool per-account that we pre-allocate, then assign an EIP when creating a nat gateway. aim is to avoid hitting EIP quota on bursty create loops. idea is:

```hcl
variable "eip_pool_ids" {
  type = list(string)
}
resource "aws_eip" "pool_alloc" {
  for_each = toset(var.eip_pool_ids)
  vpc      = true
  tags = { from = "eip-pool" }
}
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "gw" {
  for_each = var.azs
  allocation_id = aws_eip.pool_alloc[each.key].id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.private[each.key].id
  depends_on = [aws_eip.pool_alloc]
}
```

oliver: two notes:
- add `create_before_destroy = true` on the nat gateway resource to avoid transient downtime.
- for EIPs we should use `prevent_destroy = true` on the pool so a mis-configured run doesn't nuke them.

```hcl
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "gw" {
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
  # ...
}
resource "aws_eip" "pool_alloc" {
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
  # ...
}
```

maria: also check account EIP quota — default is small. did you add a note for SRE to request quota bump in the PR? costs + support ticket needed.

sam: yes, PR description has the quota request template and a short cost calc (roughly +$3/EIP/month). filed a support task: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2241

ethan: when people migrate existing NATGWs you'll need to `terraform import` the nat and the eip association. commands I used for a previous migration: 

```bash
# import existing EIP (by allocation id)
terraform import module.vpc.aws_eip.pool_alloc[\"us-east-1a\"] eipalloc-0123456789abcdef0
# import nat gateway
terraform import module.vpc.aws_nat_gateway.gw[\"us-east-1a\"] nat-0abcdef1234567890
```

sam: included those exact steps in the migration checklist in the PR. please follow order: import EIP -> import NAT -> `terraform plan` -> apply.

jess: small nit: the plan in CI shows `aws_eip_association` changing for one subnet pair — could be due to resource key mismatch. try normalizing the map keys to AZ names instead of indexes.

sam: good catch, I'll patch that. tagging for reviews: @jess @oliver (would love approval once tests pass).

infra-bot: CI status — terraform plan (staging) completed successfully in 18s :white_check_mark:

jess: LGTM after the key normalization change. do a canary rollout to one AZ first. :thumbsup:

oliver: +1 on canary. I'll monitor routing tables during apply.

sam: thanks everyone — merging later today after a final staging apply.
